english.title: Fail to comply with conditions when acting under the authority of a licence - Ukraine
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), purported to act under the authority of a licence issued under regulation 9 of the Ukraine (European Union Financial Sanctions) (No.2) Regulations 2014, but failed to comply with a condition or conditions included in the licence, namely **(..SPECIFY CONDITION OR CONDITIONS..)
english.legislation: Contrary to regulations 9(6) and 12(1) of the Ukraine (European Union Financial Sanctions) (No.2) Regulations 2014.
english.pointstoprove:
date and location
a person acting
under the authority of a licence
failed to comply with conditions included in the licence

investigatoraction.description: DNA Samples: If crime scene stain present - take evidential sample If no crime scene stain and DNA not confirmed on PNC - take Criminal Justice sample. If DNA confirmed on PNC - CJ sample not required
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes:
(i) Regulation 14 states that consent of the Attorney General is needed to bring proceedings for this offence, except for summary offences.
(ii) For provisions regarding the laying of proceedings, see regulation 13 for full detail of how proceedings may be brought in the relevant jurisdiction.
(iii) This offence may be committed by conduct wholly or partly outside the United Kingdom when it is conduct of a UK national or a body incorporated or constituted under the law of the United Kingdom.

other.penalty:
Either way -

Summary: maximum 12 months imprisonment and/or a fine.
Indictment: maximum 7 years imprisonment and/or fine

Time limit for prosecutions:
None

Note
In relation to an offence committed before section 154(1) of the Criminal Justice Act 2003 comes into force, the reference to 12 months imprisonment in relation to summary offences, above, is to be read as a reference to 6 months imprisonment.
